text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — All‑hands this Thursday 10:00am PT. Short agenda, 45m total. Please read the note and drop any Qs here so we can triage for the live Q&A. :loudspeaker:

miguel: Confirming we'll do the lightning demo of the routing optimizer?

sarah: Yep — Miguel will show the routing optimizer + fallback policy in a 10m demo. Expect the product update + two policy items after.

kate: Agenda sketch (will paste to calendar):
```
1) 10:00 - 10:10 CEO update (market + hiring)
2) 10:10 - 10:20 Product demo: routing optimizer (Miguel)
3) 10:20 - 10:30 Policy update: data retention + audit logging (Jen)
4) 10:30 - 10:40 Ops: Dedicated capacity SLA changes (Tom)
5) 10:40 - 10:45 Q&A (live)
```

jen: For the Policy update I'll cover: retention window baseline change (90 -> 180 days for logs), opt-in extended retention for enterprise customers, and the new audit-log export format. Will paste the short FAQ here before the meeting.

tom: Ops will announce the Dedicated capacity SLA tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and the new burst-policy defaults. No customer impact for current committed contracts — just opt-in for upgrades.

sarah: Logistics: meeting will be recorded and the recording + slides will be posted to this thread and the All‑hands doc. If you can't make it, add questions here or use the anonymous form: https://forms.gle/RedwoodAH-questions

miguel: Tiny ask — engineering folks: please add any tech flags or regressions to the thread so I can pick one demo example that resonates. e.g., "high latency on long-context Llama-2-70B" or similar.

kate: I'll send a calendar update in ~5m with the agenda + dial-in. Please RSVP so we can estimate Q time.

sarah: Prep note for managers: collect top 2 cross-team tickets to surface in the 2-min "what's blocking us" segment. We won't call out individuals.

allhands_bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood-recordings.internal/1798004321. Slides: https://drive.redwood/Allhands-1798004321.pdf (posted after meeting). :white_check_mark:

miguel: Thanks everyone — see you Thursday. If you have a demo dataset you want me to use, paste a short sample below.

kate: quick Q — will there be time to discuss the new pricing page?

jen: If it's short, we can cover pricing as a 90s callout after Ops. Otherwise let's triage to product sync.

tom: +1 on triage if we need a deeper convo.

sarah: We'll try to fit a 60-90s pricing note. If it needs details we'll follow up with a dedicated session. Please keep Qs coming here. :sparkles:
